subject: Add --no-baseline flag to ARC bench (run ON arm only)
description: Add a --no-baseline runner flag to bench/arc_agi3_zonoid/runner.py that skips the no_zonoid (cold/baseline) arm and runs only the zonoid_on arm. Thread no_baseline from main() through run_real into both run_benchmarking_repo (guard the unconditional baseline _run_official_cli_arm call ~line 405) and the inline direct path (guard the cold_cfg arm). When no_baseline is set but zonoid is not supported/active, error out (nothing to run). Report still renders from the single arm's records. Verify: --dry-run unaffected; --help shows the flag; py_compile ok.
